title: Figure 6: Torques on a magnetic moment in a magnetic field subject to electrical current
description: Vector diagram captioned 'Figure 6. Torques on a Magnetic Moment in a Magnetic Field and Subject to an Electrical Current', showing a magnetic moment S precessing about B_eff, with arrows labeled 'STT', 'Damping' and the precession term 'gamma S x B_eff', and a red spiral trajectory. It accompanies section '3.2 STT Experiments' and the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation (Equation 1).
